name: volkermatthes-design
description: Shared design of letmeshowyou and Rudel: tokens, icons and the DesignKit Swift package

scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @volkermatthes/design generate && pnpm --filter @volkermatthes/icons ios && pnpm --filter @volkermatthes/icons android
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @volkermatthes/design check && pnpm --filter @volkermatthes/icons ios:check && pnpm --filter @volkermatthes/icons android:check
